yaṃ, gahapati, pāṇ'ātipātī pāṇ'ātipātapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikam'pi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikam'pi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati, pāṇ'ātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti.
paṭiccasamuppādaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
